blocking_failures: behavior_in_tests: The instruction requires split expansion and parent preservation, validation and overflow cases, interleaved grouping, signed residual allocation, exact output schema, and clean-directory execution, but the tests cover only a small subset of these behaviors.

valid_failure_modes: The requirement to preserve split parent totals refers to documented split metadata, but neither instruction.md nor docs/format.md defines the parent-total semantics. A capable implementation can therefore fail because of an underspecified requirement.
